topic: Weather Safety Precautions and Storm Signals
key_concepts: Wear light-colored breathable clothing and use sunblock on sunny days
Drink water before feeling thirsty to avoid dehydration
Limit sun exposure especially between 11:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m.
Stay indoors away from windows during high winds
Use umbrella, raincoat, boots, and warm jacket on rainy days
Secure loose yard items and keep pets indoors during storms
